feature_summary.treatment: Each feature is cross-sectionally z-scored per day vs peers (clipped to ±3), then ALL features feed one pooled Ridge (alpha=100) — there is NO per-stock feature selection; every stock uses the same feature set. Label = the stock's next-20-day return rank vs peers.

caveats: rank-percentile regression proxy, not a true pairwise ranker

vc5_diagnostics.note: Sector-neutral IC ~= raw-liquid IC => skill is WITHIN-sector, not a sector bet (corrects the earlier 'mining-only' read). But weak: decile spread non-monotonic on liquid names, edge dies ~1.5% cost, Deflated Sharpe ~0.55. Survivorship deferred.
